evals.name: select-authorization-model-from-platform
evals.prompt: I am building an ABAP Cloud app on SAP BTP and need to restrict access to records by business role and region. Which authorization model and code-level check should I use?
evals.expected_output: Uses the ABAP Cloud IAM/business-catalog/business-role model and discusses released CL_ABAP_AUTHORIZATION and/or CDS access control as appropriate, rather than defaulting to classic PFCG-only guidance.

evals.name: ask-platform-before-prescribing-auth
evals.prompt: How should I implement an authorization check in my ABAP application? I haven't said which SAP platform or language version it uses.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the platform context affects the recommendation and asks a focused question or clearly distinguishes ABAP Cloud IAM from classic AUTHORITY-CHECK/PFCG instead of assuming one.
